list: The beverage dispenser, food trays, and the countertop are spotlessly clean and in apple-pie order. A small tip: only kids who finish their meals are allowed to take a piece of fruit candy from the jar.

A decorative pool of cold water. The balls floating on the surface can be used as ammunition for water fights in the hot spring. When the kids get bored at home, they sometimes try to figure out which ball is the roundest.

A peculiarly-shaped awning, supposedly made with wood and canvas that meet the standards to build a watercraft out of. Chuck once came home with a broken boat, and that's how the shop ended up with a new awning.
'A bench built from ceramic tiles. It was only after completion that we found out it was too short, so there was no choice but to use it as a flower stand for potted plants instead.
A panoramic display showing the scenic beauty of the misty Fashion Street. The past and present of Fashion Street are on full display here.

Old advertisement signs and banners that now serve as a small part of the shop's memories on its wall. Every time a Sankta tour group visits the store, this 'slightly sweet' hot dog becomes the top-selling item on the Fashion Street.

A flooring made of tiles of different colors and styles. Their carefree arrangement reflects the shop owner's nonchalant personality. The color of the sunset, the color of the hot springs, and the color of home.
'Careful. This pen can take your life without making any noise whatsoever.'
theme: The 'White Volcano' cafe recreated through Enis's drawings and comments from other operators who spent time in Siesta. The place where the children embarked on their first adventure.

list:
You bid farewell to the Siestan volcano with everybody else.
'It's so nice that all of you are still here by my side.'
During the So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home event, obtain Operator Bryophyta.

You followed the Fashion Street pamphlet, did some sightseeing, and met a passionate Siestan teenager.
Enis invites you to visit the shops of Fashion Street, just as always.
During the So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home event, spend 2,400 Fluffy Critter Wool in ['White Volcano'].

You brought 'White Volcano' even more orders.
Enis was very happy to see everything completely sold out, only to find his cash register stuffed with pink fluff.
Complete all the content in [Dolly's Task List] and collect the rewards.

You've completed Dolly's mission in the most outstanding way possible.
'The northern winds, seeds, fur... Not enough! Let's have some more fun!'
Collect 250,000 Spending Coupons from Siestan Fashion Street.

You helped Snowsant's Shop earn a considerable amount of Spending Coupons.
The small shop that's been raking in big bucks on Fashion Street has become an afternoon conversation topic to many Siestans.
Complete all stages in [A Holiday at the Hot Springs] with 3-star ratings.

You've spent a summer full of fun with the fluffy critters.
When they leave, they disappear surreptitiously without a peep, but you will never forget those strawberry-ice-cream dipped hoofprints.
Complete all stages in [Treasurehunting in Siesta] with 3-star ratings.

The furry creatures showed you some crazy good floating and surfing skills.
Their valiant figures as they leapt from the springwater were photographed—but it would be so much cooler if the water were shopped into lava.
Complete all stages in [Treasurehunting in Siesta] on Challenge Mode.

You've witnessed the fluffy critters compete in lava freediving.
When these critters lined up and leapt into the volcano's crater, their cries formed a joyous chorus.
Complete all stages in [Surfing the Lava] on Challenge Mode (except SL-MO-1).

You ventured into the dangers of the volcano and returned safely with first-hand survey data.
These precious data will become a priceless exhibit in Volcano Museum of Siesta.
Clear SL-MO-1 in [Surfing the Lava] with a 3-star rating.

You reunite with what was once Siesta, amid the haze and ashes.
The beach will forever be in your heart.
set: So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home Engraved Medal Set

An engraved medal set that records the fluffy fantasies of the Siestan summer.
The things that happened in the past don't just stay in the past. They will always be with us, only in a different way.
With the smoke of the volcano cleared, the sun shines as bright and warm as always.
